body:
Enhance antigravity-booster for compatibility with Antigravity 2.3.1 releases:

1. Update `lib/brain.mjs` (`readBrain` function) to support loading local spec files with extensions `.json`, `.csv`, `.pdf`, `.txt` in addition to `.md`. Specifically, check if `idOrPrefix` matches a file path or supported file extension (`.md`, `.json`, `.csv`, `.pdf`, `.txt`) and exists as a file.
2. Update `lib/agy.mjs` (`isAgyTimeout` function) to detect MCP connection and tool call timeout error strings returned by AGY 2.3.1 (e.g. `Error: MCP tool call timed out`, `Error: MCP server connection timed out`).
3. Add unit tests in `test/phase2.test.mjs` verifying `readBrain` accepts `.json` and `.csv` local spec files.
4. Add unit tests in `test/security.test.mjs` verifying `isAgyTimeout` returns `true` for MCP timeout errors.

Acceptance criteria:
- `readBrain('spec.json')` and `readBrain('tasks.csv')` load as local-spec files when they exist.
- `isAgyTimeout` returns true for `Error: MCP tool call timed out` and `Error: MCP server connection timed out`.
- `npm test` passes completely.
title: feat(agy-2.3): support json/csv/pdf/txt specs in readBrain and detect MCP timeouts in isAgyTimeout
